note: Small Chariton River access with a concrete boat ramp north of Callao, reached by a mile of unimproved MDC road. MDC lists designated camping but maps no camping spot; the only place a vehicle can stop is the gravel boat-ramp lot. --Claude
summary: DROP CANDIDATE (ramp-lot camping): area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites' but the 10/21/2021 map shows only a parking lot and concrete boat ramp (no camping symbol), GIS has no camping point, and no brochure is posted; vehicles are restricted to roads and parking areas, so camping can only be in the boat-ramp lot. WATERFRONT riverfront -> not waterfront: the lot sits ~40 m back from the Chariton behind a tree buffer and the only opening is the ramp lane. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights written manual. Pin = the lot. Phone matches.
flags: CRITERIA / DROP CANDIDATE (lot allowance): area page 'Things to Do When You Visit': 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; 'This area has a concrete boat ramp that provides access to the Chariton River.' 40 acres. The map (Last Updated 10/21/2021) legend has only Parking Lot, Concrete Boat Ramp, MDC Land, Non-MDC Road, MDC Unimproved Road, Stream, Forest - no Primitive Camping symbol anywhere. MDC's GIS camping layer has no point for Dodd Access; the parking layer has one lot (1361). The area regulations on the page say 'Vehicle use is restricted to graveled and paved roads and established parking areas', so the only place a vehicle camper can be is the boat-ramp lot: a gravel lot ~50 x 25 m at the end of the unimproved road, with the ramp lane running off its NW corner to the river. That is the ramp-lot camping the brief treats as a drop (as 13897 Cross Timbers in p3-334).

WATERFRONT (riverfront -> not waterfront): measured on the 0.46 m/px frame, the lot's west edge is ~35-45 m from the Chariton River (~40-50 m wide here), with a wooded bank between; the only opening to the water is the ramp lane itself. There is no camping spot to measure from, and the ramp lot fails the open-apron rule (ramp, trees). No MDC photo shows a view, so it goes down to not waterfront, not riverview.
ACCESS: the map draws the mile from Echo Avenue as 'MDC Unimproved Road' (a dirt/gravel lane along a field edge on imagery). No 4WD or ford wording; the lane may be impassable when wet (unstated).
PIN: stored 39.83543,-92.68378 = GIS lot 1361, the ramp lot. Fine for what is there.
